confucius.oneLineEn: Founded the Confucian ethical-political tradition on ren (humaneness), ritual propriety, and junzi cultivation.

buddha.oneLineEn: Recast Indian thought on life, attachment, and freedom through dukkha, dependent origination, non-self, and liberation.

plato.oneLineEn: His theory of Forms and the Republic make him one of the core sources of Western philosophy.

aristotle.oneLineEn: Built a systematic philosophical framework around substance, final cause, and virtue ethics.

kant.oneLineEn: Through critical philosophy, reset the bounds of knowledge, freedom, and the moral law.

rawls.oneLineEn: Reshaped contemporary political philosophy's problem-frame through justice as fairness.
